title: docs(pm-skill): reconcile platform-readings.md lines 26–28 (merge-tree "does not apply the driver ⇒ under-reports") with the measured 349–350 (driver applied when registered; the hazard is a deferred content judgement)
body:
Filed by the director seat at the #16379 ruling (decision batch #63, 2026-09-07, option A: land the new lines, reconcile the old ones in their own diff).

## The contradiction

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`:

- **Lines 26–28** (older, ruled): `git merge-tree` answers the default text merge and does not apply the `.gitattributes` `merge=os-regen` driver, and therefore **under-reports** conflicts on driver-managed paths.
- **Lines 349–350** (PR #16379, measured on git 2.43.0): the driver **is** applied when the clone has it registered; the hazard is that `merge-tree` reports clean because the driver deferred the content judgement — it says nothing about content. Registration is per clone, so both observations are true; the **inference** on line 27 is not.

PR #15885's `AGENTS.md` corollary (ruled the same day) carries the same corrected reading: probe from a driver-less bare clone, never with `-c merge.os-regen.driver=`.

## Scope

- Rewrite line 27 (and 26/28 if they restate the inference) to the registered-driver hazard, in the register the ledger uses; keep the line count neutral (the ceiling is #16386's business, not this card's).
- Cross-check the wording against `AGENTS.md` §11's corollary once PR #15885 lands so the two governed texts say one thing.
- Governed surface: draft PR, human merge, `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] 26–28 and 349–350 read as one rule with two clauses (registered clone vs driver-less clone)
- [ ] no line-count change
- [ ] wording agrees with `AGENTS.md` §11 corollary

Refs PR #16379 (open question), PR #15885, #15871.
